# s427 — Relay texts wrap the handoff note-kind sentence at 88 columns

s412 rewrapped the relay texts to 88 columns, but only for a project that leaves `handoff_requires_note_kind` unset. With the key set, `handoff_policy_text` still lands in both relay texts as one long line.

**Findings:** s412 review 2026-10-30, later note: with handoff_requires_note_kind set, ai relay prints a ~394-430 column line from handoff_policy_text · **Size:** S · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** rewording the policy sentence; changing the skill text or `ai instructions` beyond the wrap.

## Why

The s412 width test (`test_RelayTexts_ProseLines_FitIn88Columns`) covers the finish and matrix variants only. A project that sets a handoff note kind gets a 394-430 column line in `ai relay` and `ai relay-orchestrator` (the length depends on the kind name). The CHANGELOG entry for s412 says so.

## Files

- `src/slicer/ai.py`: `handoff_policy_text` (about lines 136-146) and its use in `relay_shared_sections`. It is also used by the skill text and `ai instructions` (about lines 1131 and 1304), so wrap only where it enters the relay texts, or wrap everywhere and update those goldens.
- `tests/test_ai.py`: extend the 88-column test with a note-kind variant.
- `tests/fixtures/relay-contract-v10.json` (or the current contract golden), only if a golden variant sets the key.

- `test_RelayTexts_NoteKindSet_ProseLinesFitIn88Columns`: with `handoff_requires_note_kind` set to `implementation report`, no prose line of `ai relay` or `ai relay-orchestrator` is over 88 columns. It fails today on the policy line.
